evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/a/a calls the AssetUpdater base constructor with "Cache" and binds AssetVersion key "cache_version".

Its update method displays "Downloading main game assets..", downloads a ZIP, extracts the main game cache payload and deliberately excludes the separate sprites/configs trees handled by sibling updaters.

candidates.note: CacheUpdater follows the concrete Cache label, cache_version key and main-game-assets download/extraction path.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/a/b is an AssetUpdater subclass whose AssetVersion is keyed by "client_version".
Its update method displays "Downloading client..", downloads the remote client artifact to the client update directory and reports success based on the resulting file.

candidates.note: ClientUpdater follows the client_version key and explicit client-download path.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/a/c calls the AssetUpdater base constructor with "Configs" and binds AssetVersion key "config_version".
Its update method displays "Downloading game configs..", downloads the config archive and extracts it into the local config destination.

candidates.note: ConfigUpdater follows the concrete Configs label, config_version key and config-download path.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/a/d calls the AssetUpdater base constructor with "Sprites" and binds AssetVersion key "sprite_version".
Its update method displays "Downloading sprites..", downloads the sprite archive and extracts it into the local sprite destination.

candidates.note: SpriteUpdater follows the concrete Sprites label, sprite_version key and sprite-download path.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/b is a two-value enum whose surviving constant names are INVALID_REMOTE_VERSION and ERROR_DOWNLOADING.
The enum payloads are user-facing version-check and game-asset-download failure messages consumed by the shared AssetUpdater error path.

candidates.note: AssetUpdateError describes the exact updater-specific error enum.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/c constructs Cache, Sprite and Config concrete AssetUpdater instances, stores them in a list, binds the Client into each and exposes each updater through dedicated getters.

Its main check displays "Please wait, checking assets..", compares remote/local AssetVersion values, runs outdated updaters, and adds updater-specific errors such as "Error with the cache updater!", "Error with the sprite updater!" and "Error with configuration updater!".
When a version mismatch is found it prints "Updating outdated game asset: <name>" before invoking that updater.

candidates.note: AssetUpdateCoordinator owns and sequences the concrete asset updaters.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/d is abstract, owns updater name, Client reference and an error-message list, and defines abstract update(), version-info and updater-policy hooks used by the concrete asset updaters.
The base class provides shared directory creation, remote/local version parsing, ZIP extraction/file write helpers and standardized AssetUpdateError reporting.

candidates.note: AssetUpdater is the shared abstract updater contract and common file/version/error implementation.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/b/e stores a version key plus local version-file path, reads the remote versions.txt source, reads/writes local versions.dat state and exposes remote/local version doubles compared by the coordinator.
AssetUpdateCoordinator compares each updater's rs/cache/b/e remote and local version values and invokes the updater only when they differ.

candidates.note: AssetVersion encapsulates the updater's remote/local version-key state.
